Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical geographical and historical error in the very first step by misidentifying the location of the "northern English anglian Kingdom" in the Humber estuary. The Planner incorrectly associated the Humber estuary with the southern Anglian kingdom of Lindsey/Mercia. In reality, the northern Anglian kingdoms were Deira (centered on York) and Bernicia, which together formed Northumbria. The Humber estuary lies at the border between these northern kingdoms and the southern kingdom of Mercia (which controlled Lindsey). By confusing the "northern" kingdom with the southern Mercian/Lindsey area, the Planner established a false premise that led to the incorrect conclusion that the dialect was Old Mercian, whereas the correct answer is Old Northumbrian (or Old Northumbrian/Deiran).
